readme: R300 mapper decision table for the 50 NEW canonical items. board_decision.type: existing = live board commodity id (evidence-gated); register = needs-registration on the Omaha board (proposed id/unit; relax_global flags the GLOBAL_EXCLUDE \bmix\b-class trap); null = intentionally not price-tracked (pantry-static), reason given. db_path.type: usda = transcribed from USDA FoodData Central via the FDC portal search API (SR Legacy generic or Branded label data; fdc_id recorded); browser-capture = no trustworthy fetchable label, emit to capture-worklist.json. gpu = grams per board pricing unit, unit_basis states the unit it was calibrated to (r100 16x lesson). Authored 2026-07-25 by the recipe-ingredient-mapper (Fable). Board membership check: none of the new/proposed ids are in grocery/recipe-commodities.json, so every new map entry gets board=weekly.
